description: This PHP source file defines a trait named 'CliRunnerTrait' within the 'SuiteCRM\Robo\Traits' namespace. The trait provides a method 'bootstrap()' that sets up global variables, includes configuration files, and initializes environment variables necessary for running SuiteCRM from the command line interface (CLI). It primarily facilitates establishing database connections and configuring the application environment for CLI execution.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Sets up global variables, includes necessary configuration files, and initializes environment variables to enable SuiteCRM to run from CLI.
